item.title: About
item.description:
Hello! I’m Arnav Gupta, a passionate and enthusiastic individual with a keen interest in technology and creativity.

This website is build using Hugo , and Hugo-blog awesome theme.

Education

I completed my schooling from Bishop’s Co-Ed School in Pune. Currently, I am a second-year Computer Science student at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Modinagar.

Experience

  • Basic Java Programming: 2 years (2021-2023)
  • C/C++ Programming: 1 year (2023-2024)
  • Linux User: Since 2021
  • AutoCAD: 6 months

Hobbies and Interests

In my free time, I enjoy expressing my creativity through painting and pencil sketching. I also love staying active by playing sports like football, cricket, and badminton. Additionally, I have a passion for traveling and exploring new places.
